evidence.Q1: a village meeting about measures against the wolf
evidence.Q2: The monkey walks out first and points ahead.
evidence.Q3: The bushy-tailed squirrel climbs a vertical wooden ladder fixed against a house wall.
evidence.Q4: A dark, shadow-like monkey silhouette with a curled tail appears next to it.
evidence.Q5: the wolf walking right over snow at the foot of a wooded, rocky hillside
evidence.Q6: two sheer cliff edges separated by a deep open ravine
evidence.Q7: The long chain of monkeys extends from the tree on the left, swings downward and stretches across to the right rim, forming a sagging living bridge.
evidence.Q8: The lead monkey points across, then steps onto the linked monkeys and runs from left to right over their backs.
evidence.Q9: the wolf walks to the left end of the living bridge and steps out onto the linked bodies
evidence.Q10: The wolf drops between them into the ravine and passes out of view below.
